benchmark.timing: pre-create events, enqueue timed intervals, then synchronize; no JIT/allocation/copy/reference/check in timing
benchmark.correctness: NaN output prefill, complete pre/post check, finite and abs_error <= atol+rtol*abs(reference)

selection_rule: explicit previously measured configurations; retain close tile/group alternatives

analysis.identity_check: frozen source/binary; actual ENV; full matrix/metadata; correctness; trace grid/count; prior raw hashes

statistics.across_processes: median of process medians; min/max of process medians
